# RULE R5: the result is the number directly followed by a unit / flag / range / end of line; a number followed by
# name words (hours, hr, Hydroxy, tests ...) belongs to the NAME; several candidates -> UNKNOWN + warning.
@@ R5 | M | 40 | 2 hour post meal glucose
Glucose, 2 Hour Post Meal 168 mg/dL 70-140
=> Glucose | HIGH | 168
@@ R5 | M | 40 | vitamin D, 25 hydroxy
Vitamin D, 25 Hydroxy 18 ng/mL 30-100
=> Vitamin D | LOW | 18
@@ R5 | M | 40 | 25-hydroxy vitamin D3
25-Hydroxy Vitamin D3 22 ng/mL 30-100
=> 25-Hydroxy | LOW | 22
@@ R5 | M | 40 | vitamin B 12 level
Vitamin B 12 Level 150 pg/mL 200-900
=> Vitamin B 12 | LOW | 150
@@ R5 | M | 40 | vitamin B12 cobalamin
Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin) 150 pg/mL
=> Vitamin B12 | LOW | 150
@@ R5 | M | 40 | 1 hour post load glucose, unmatched name, no range
Glucose, 1 Hour Post Load 190 mg/dL
=> Glucose | UNKNOWN | 190
=> warn
@@ R5 | M | 40 | glucose 2 hr post prandial
Glucose 2 Hr Post Prandial 215 mg/dL 70-140
=> Glucose | HIGH | 215
@@ R5 | M | 40 | glucose PP (2 hrs)
Glucose PP (2 hrs) 145 mg/dL 70-140
=> Glucose | HIGH | 145
@@ R5 | M | 40 | fasting glucose with a fasting duration
Glucose, Fasting, 12 hr 320 mg/dL 70-100
=> Glucose | CRITICAL_HIGH | 320
@@ R5 | M | 40 | overnight fasting 8 hours
Glucose Fasting (8 hours) 92 mg/dL 70-100
=> Glucose | NORMAL | 92
@@ R5 | M | 40 | glucose 2 hrs after meal
Glucose 2 hrs after meal 320 mg/dL
=> Glucose | CRITICAL_HIGH | 320
@@ R5 | M | 40 | CA 19-9 (digits and a dash inside the name)
CA 19-9 45 U/mL <37
=> CA 19-9 | HIGH | 45
@@ R5 | M | 40 | CA 15.3 is ambiguous: two numbers before the unit
CA 15.3 52 U/mL <30
=> CA | UNKNOWN
=> warn
@@ R5 | M | 40 | interleukin 6 is ambiguous: two numbers
Interleukin 6 12 pg/mL <7
=> Interleukin | UNKNOWN
